name: heldout-docs
about: HELD OUT. Written from the raw README text before any hybrid-retrieval code existed, from sections the contextmesh-docs suite does not ask about. Never used to choose or calibrate anything; run once to evaluate. Same author as the code, so not independent: questions written by someone who has not seen the implementation are still wanted.

answerable.q: Which checkpoint mode does a served session use by default?
What does restarting the server fail to restore?
Which MCP tool causes a session commit?
What does the unresolved_entities health signal count?
Why is checkpointing only on exit risky?
When should a session be served without ever writing to it?
What graph node type represents a task in the runner?
Does a saved graph keep each node's embedding?
Where does each dashboard panel get its data?
Which document records the original capture frame by frame?

out_of_scope: Which airline has the most legroom in economy?
What is a good recipe for sourdough bread?
